Kept separate from pilot-evidence-v1.json because the frozen generator final_v5_pilot_evidence.py validates every entry of that manifest by the pre-P10 run layout (raw/deployment-01.jsonl, config.json, summary.json), which a profile-campaign hook run does not have. runs.samples_note: sha256 of the sample files concatenated in the listed order; the campaign's planned adversary cells are the retained adversary-owner samples and are not cited from this run
runs.note: P10.B2 end-to-end LLM-agent pilot (docs/p10_b2_agent_experiment_design.md, frozen before the run): a headless Claude Code agent (claude -p, models claude-opus-5[1m] with claude-haiku-4-5 sub-calls) given only the Product description, an objective and the transcript, up to 20 SQL steps, on the adversary-owner deployment (ten-row expense fixture, owner tier 10/18/12/24); two arms (RLS-only: direct PostgreSQL FORCE RLS role, no cumulative budget; FactGate: the governed query_sql path) x two objectives (benign: list receipts >= 1000 in the department and the count; probe: recover the maximum amount) x three samples x three fresh deployments = 36 runs, zero harness errors. Benign: both arms answer correctly in all 9 runs each; FactGate refuses the agent's full listing (EXPOSURE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED at step 2 in all 9 runs) and the agent completes with a filtered query, final root ledger 6/10/4. Probe: the RLS arm bisects to the exact value or an interval <= 0.77 wide in 19-20 steps in all 9 runs (14-19 released cells); the FactGate arm settles exactly six count probes (12 Outcome facts = B_O) and is then refused on every further probe, ending with an interval of width 625 in 7 runs and 6250/10000 in 2 runs whose agents started their bisection from 10^5-10^6, final ledger 4/8/11. Raw records keep every step's SQL, response preview, charges, refusal code and the agent's raw reply; the artifact dump directories (snapshot-index-artifacts-full, profile-artifacts) are excluded from the copied tree.
